name: mass cure wounds
lore:
# On the Harmonious Restoration: *Mass Cure Wounds*

To cast *Mass Cure Wounds* is to orchestrate a symphony of vitality. The caster does not merely pull at the Weave; they braid a golden tapestry across the air. Shaping this magic feels like a sudden, searing warmth—as if one’s very blood has turned to liquid sunlight, rushing toward the palms in a rhythmic thrum.

Visually, the spell manifests as a pale, amber ripple, cascading outward like a stone cast into a still pond of starlight. Where this radiance touches, jagged rents in mail and skin alike seal with a soft, melodic hum. It is a profound mending that transcends individual agony, knitting the spirits of the wounded into a singular, resilient whole.

Scholars trace its codification to the Siege of the Weeping Vale. Legend speaks of Saint Elara, who, surrounded by her fallen battalion, refused to choose who lived. She cast her spirit wide, demanding the Weave sustain them all. It is said the resulting surge was so potent that white lilies bloomed from the blood-soaked mud before the soldiers even stood. Use this gift with reverence; it is the breath of the heavens made manifest.
